violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.original_code: HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or regis
violation_type.title: HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or registered, home must comply with the department's applicable rules and standards (26 TAC §HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or regis)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or registered, home must comply with the department's applicable rules and standards
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder was observed caring for one unrelated child 3 months old during the follow-up inspection.

finding_variants.text: The permit holder was observed caring for one unrelated child 3 months old during the follow-up inspection.

The operation is on automatic suspension due to not paying required fees and cannot care for children. Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, childcare was provided after the provider's listing was automatically suspended on 3/15/24.
